vector-store-lite

Embedded vector store on stdlib sqlite3 with float32 blobs, metadata filters compiled to parameterised SQL, exact search and seeded random-hyperplane LSH Python package `trysac-vector-store-lite`, import name `vector_store_lite`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): data schema and SQL compilation
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): existing test structure
